description: This file contains functions for extracting various directives and levels from text bodies, including think, verbose, fast, notice, elevated, reasoning, and status directives, as well as related type definitions and imports.

methods.name: matchLevelDirective
methods.description: Matches a level directive in the body text based on provided names, returning start/end positions and raw level if found.

methods.name: extractLevelDirective
methods.description: Extracts a level directive from the body text, normalizes it, and returns cleaned text with directive info.

methods.name: extractSimpleDirective
methods.description: Extracts a simple directive (without level) from the body text and returns cleaned text.

methods.name: extractThinkDirective
methods.description: Extracts a 'think' directive and its level from the body text.

methods.name: extractVerboseDirective
methods.description: Extracts a 'verbose' directive and its level from the body text.

methods.name: extractFastDirective
methods.description: Extracts a 'fast' directive and its boolean level from the body text.

methods.name: extractNoticeDirective
methods.description: Extracts a 'notice' directive and its level from the body text.

methods.name: extractElevatedDirective
methods.description: Extracts an 'elevated' directive and its level from the body text.

methods.name: extractReasoningDirective
methods.description: Extracts a 'reasoning' directive and its level from the body text.

methods.name: extractStatusDirective
methods.description: Extracts a 'status' directive from the body text.
